Episode 119: Banquet at the Sword Emperor Castle (7)
What appeared by breaking through the floor of the arena was a monster they had never seen before in their lives.
'What the hell is this, a demon!? Where did this thing suddenly come from...!'
It seemed to have a massive body that was hard to believe even when looking at it with both eyes.
Jin and Lata were thrown into the air by its mouth, and in the meantime, Ron penetrated and struck a blow.
The sword that only the head of the Hairan family could possess, 'Rashid,' was dyed in a dazzling light.
Swoosh...!
As if a wave had hit, the space was rippling along the trajectory where Rashid had moved.
Although it hadn't reached the realm of completely annihilating objects, it was the blow of an infinitely powerful knight.
The mountain-like body of the monster that had just appeared was unbelievably being split in half.
Black blood poured out like a flood, and before the blood could stain the floor, a continuous barrage of attacks followed, tearing the monster into hundreds of pieces.
"Knights of Hairan, prioritize protecting the guests. Assemble all the knights on standby in the castle. Execute a first-class terror response!"
As Dante issued the order, the knights deployed their swords in an orderly manner.
Screams of ordinary guests spread everywhere.
It pushed away the pleasant tension that Jin and Lata's duel had created, and the real danger had come. Naturally, most of the guests had never experienced such terror.
Even warriors were no exception.
Who would have imagined that in Sword Emperor Castle, a terror like this would occur during a banquet hosted by Ron Hairan after 22 years?
Crash, creak-!
It wasn't just one.
Massive monsters were revealing themselves in various places throughout the vast arena.
An earthquake occurred as they broke through the floor and sprung up, causing the ceiling to shake as if it would collapse at any moment.
The columns, which stood like trees, broke, and the screams of ordinary guests intensified the chaos.
Fortunately, however, more than 30% of the people sitting in the audience were warriors who visited the Sword Emperor Castle as distinguished guests.
"We'll help too!"
"Open the way, and let the knights of Hairan evacuate the guests!"
"Black King Corps, protect the guests. We'll take the compensation later!"
Warriors shouted as they took out their weapons.
If it had been an ordinary situation, Hairan would have refused their help.
They could not allow their pride to rely on external forces at their own stronghold.
But now, there were too many guests who could be killed in an instant, and the fact that the terror had already 'occurred' was a humiliation in itself.
If those attending the banquet were to return as corpses, it would have caused irreparable damage to the reputation of Hairan, the best swordmaster.
"Damn it, what is this...!"
Lata, who landed on the ground, looked up at the monster. One was already torn apart by Ron to the point where it was hard to recognize its form, but there were at least ten more visible.
And that wasn't the end.
Intense vibrations were felt continuously from the floor. More of those huge monsters were attacking Hairan one after another.
"Dante!"
As Ron tore apart the second monster, he searched for his grandson.
"Yes, grandfather!"
"It's impossible to gather all the knights. They are already spread out outside."
"Outside, too...!"
"As a knight who will become the master of Sword Emperor Castle, take responsibility and evacuate the ordinary guests."
Only Ron was aware of the fact that the monsters were spreading outside the Sword Emperor Castle as well.
As if Jin and Lata were living in a different world, Ron was a being of a different class from all the warriors here.
Dante nodded heavily.
'Is the outside under attack too?'
The moment Ron mentioned the outside, two words simultaneously came to the warriors' minds.
War.
Someone had declared war on Hairan, or perhaps Bemonte, in the form of a surprise attack.
The scale was too large to be seen as a simple terror attack by anyone.
And the forces that could employ such monsters on a large scale...
None.
None of the forces present here were known to use monsters. Humans couldn't control monsters in the first place.
The only possibility was the Zifels. But they had never waged war using monsters, and they had no reason to suddenly attack Hairan either.
"Doesn't it feel like a demon dragon... Are they demons?"
Quikantel spoke while casting a protective barrier.
All the dragons in the arena, including her and Murakan, thought of demons.
Dragons, unlike the warriors, all had memories of seeing demons control monsters at least once.
"Quikantel. Aren't those monsters a bit too crude to be considered demons?"
"Strong energy that even high-level monsters can't possess, and you call them crude?"
"It's not about being strong or weak, the flow of energy is strangely unnatural. As if someone forced it. It's also a monster I've never seen before."
"I do feel that way. How surprisingly you're making such plausible deductions, Murakan. Anyway, this is not a normal situation. You better get involved, protect your contractor as well."

Jin was already facing the monsters with his demonic sword. He couldn't turn a giant monster into a chunk of meat in an instant like Ron, but thanks to Jin and Lata protecting the center, the damage to the audience was reduced.
"Of course."
Murakan transformed into his true form and soared into the sky.
By then, the ceiling had already been shattered, and boulders as large as houses were falling in all directions.
"Murakan! Help Dante, more monsters are coming!"
"I am Murakan, Jin Runcandel's guardian dragon. I will protect you according to my contractor's will, so do not be afraid."
Murakan's deep and dark voice echoed as the sky turned black. A curtain of aura spread out behind his wings, covering the sky.
As this was a banquet held in Bemonte, many imperial contracted magicians were in attendance. Their guardian dragons also followed Murakan into the sky.

Murakan naturally became the center of the dragons. The other contracted dragons were not afraid of monsters, but rather, they were unable to reveal their dignity in the presence of this black dragon that had awakened after a thousand years.
"Rroaarr-!"
The giant monsters extended their snouts towards the dragons.
Magic power was gathering in their snouts. They looked like magical cannons, and the spheres gathered in the monsters' snouts had a similar effect.
The problem was that they carried an energy that deviated from the typical magical cannons.
Although they couldn't compare to Cojek's artillery, they still had enough firepower to be called a disaster.
Twelve giant monsters were gathering their magical power like this.
Soon, they fired their cannons simultaneously, and their eyes were momentarily blinded by a bright white light. It seemed powerful enough to turn a small castle into dust without a trace.
"These lowly creatures don't know their place."
Murakan effortlessly blocked their magical attacks. The curtain of aura he had spread out created a whirlwind, swallowing up the magical cannons.
However, that wasn't all that was being fired from the arena.

Outside, monsters were shooting magical cannons at the walls of Sword Emperor Castle. The shock of the walls collapsing was transmitted into the castle, and from then on, there was nothing that could be done.
Unless one was an omnipotent being.
Casualties were inevitable, as there were far more monsters outside firing their cannons than in the arena.
Even if it was Chiron, not Ron, who was present, it would have been impossible to prevent all damage completely.
But the attack had just begun.
Suddenly, the fragments of the giant monsters torn apart by Ron and the warriors began to undergo a strange mutation.
Like clay sticking together, the flesh that was close to each other mixed together, creating a new shape.
It was unrecognizable.
Before the transformation was complete, they were continuously struck by lightning and slashed by Sigmund. However, it was impossible to completely eliminate the tens of thousands of pieces of flesh.
'Human...!?'
The squirming flesh was gradually taking on a shape closer to that of a human.
Using monsters to create biological golems.
The mass of flesh filling the warriors' field of vision was precisely that.
At that sight, even the veterans who had experienced all kinds of battlefields were momentarily taken aback.
It seemed as if the gates of hell had opened at Sword Emperor Castle.
Dante, Lata, the other warriors, and magicians were all gritting their teeth and fighting against the rushing biological golems.
Regardless of their martial arts level, everyone was appalled by this unfamiliar and horrifying situation.
Jin had the most composed gaze among the warriors. He had encountered these damned biological golems more than once or twice before, and even felt a sense of deja vu.
'Kinzelo, Zipfel, Bemonte. The giant monster is a golem created by one of those three.'
He had directly confirmed that all three were developing biological golems.
Which faction was behind this, and what their purpose was for attacking Hairan at this point, was unknown for now.
One thing was certain.
Regardless of which faction was responsible, Hairan would suffer significant damage.
It was like a bolt from the blue for Jin.
It just so happened that this incident occurred while he was dueling with Lata.
The central arena of Hairan, which used to look like a beautiful white desert, was now unrecognizable.
It was just filled with wriggling biological golems and giant monsters.
Crash, rumble...!
Eventually, the entire wall in the distance collapsed, revealing the outside scenery.
A scene even more chaotic than the arena unfolded there.
Knights and dragons were trying to hold them back, but the corpses of servants and ordinary soldiers were visible in various places.
There were also many casualties inside the arena.
Jin instinctively turned his head to check on Veradin's position.
His magic had not been seen yet.
This made Jin uneasy. He suddenly wondered if the attack was being directed by Veradin, whose mind had been manipulated.
If it were the Veradin Jin knew, he would have been busier than anyone else saving people in such a situation.
But there was no time to confirm Veradin's whereabouts.
The number of biological golems was increasing, and Jin had been breaking through the encirclement since earlier.
Every time Sigmund spewed lightning, a bunch of biological golems were swept away. Jin, who had been slashing through them, suddenly stopped.
Between the remains of the biological golems and monsters, in the distance, a familiar robe entered his field of vision.
A group of people wearing plain gray robes without any patterns.
As soon as Jin saw them, he couldn't help but feel his hair stand on end.
Those gray robes belonged to the 'Phantom Group'.
